# CheckMate PDI Exxpert (checkmatepdi.com)
> Independent Car Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) & Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection Service across Mumbai & Thane.

## Summary
CheckMate PDI Exxpert provides independent, certified on-site car inspection services for car buyers. Every vehicle undergoes a 350+ point checklist, including paint thickness measurement, engine bay evaluation, electrical diagnostic checks, odometer verification, and photo-backed evidence. Full digital reports are delivered via WhatsApp and Email within 15 minutes of inspection.

## Pricing
- Inspection Packages start at ₹999.

## Service Coverage Areas
- Mumbai Western Line Corridor: Churchgate, Marine Lines, Charni Road, Grant Road, Mumbai Central, Mahalaxmi, Lower Parel, Prabhadevi, Dadar, Mahim, Bandra, Khar, Santacruz, Vile Parle, Andheri, Jogeshwari, Goregaon, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali, Dahisar, Mira Road, Bhayandar, Naigaon, Vasai Road, Nallasopara, Virar.
- Thane & Central Corridor: Thane West, Majiwada, Ghodbunder Road, Kalwa, Mumbra, Diva, Kopar, Dombivli, Thakurli, Kalyan.

## Key Offerings & Checklist Highlights
- 350+ point comprehensive inspection.
- 150+ high-resolution photo evidence report.
- Unbiased third-party condition grading (OK, Minor Issue, Major Issue).
- Digital report delivery within 15 minutes.
- Pre-registration new car PDI & used car pre-purchase inspections.
